name: Jean-Jacques Gibson
original_name: ジャン・ジャック・ギブスン
source:
Gibson worked for 30 years as a Science Cop, but when his wife, Alice, was killed by a Snatcher during the "Bio-roid Panic of '46," he joined the Junker Agency as a "runner."

He is a rather stern, quiet man with a love for antiques. He lives with his daughter, Katrina and their dog who is named after Gibson's late wife.

[From [url=http://www.justinaaron.com/thekremlin/gibson.html]The Kremlin[/url]]
